When wielded, a strange yet heavenly breeze kicks up around you.|Inventory|BotW}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 28 |durability = 45 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} The Goddess Sword is a [[Weapon]] that may be obtained at random within a [[Treasure Chest]] that appears after tapping "The Legend of Zelda" series {{SS|-}} [[Link]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. It has 28 attack power and a durability of 45. The Goddess Sword houses the fire of the [[Hylia|Goddess Hylia]]. It is said that a "heavenly breeze" kicks up around its wielder. Being made of metal, the Goddess Sword will attract [[Lightning]] if it is equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. It will also sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but it can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. If it is exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], the Goddess Sword will not burn like a wooden Weapon would. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_057" |Life = 45 |Power = 28 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 17 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|White Sword of the Sky}} The White Sword of the Sky is a [[Weapon]] that is obtained as a completion reward for the [[Side Quest]] "[[The Mother Goddess Statue]]".{{Cite|Answering the pleas of the Goddess Statues at the three springs of wisdom, power, and courage has restored the Mother Goddess Statue in the Forgotten Temple, from whom you received the White Sword of the Sky.|Adventure Log|TotK}} After the Side Quest is complete, [[Link]] may reobtain the Weapon by bringing the [[Mother Goddess Statue]] [[Dinraal's Claw]], [[Naydra's Claw]], and [[Farosh's Claw]].{{Cite|Devout swordsman. Have you lost the White Sword of the Sky? Dinraal... Naydra... Farosh... Offer the claws of the spirits, and I shall return the White Sword of the Sky to you.|Mother Goddess Statue|TotK}} The White Sword of the Sky may also be obtained at random within a [[Treasure Chest]] that appears after scanning a {{TLoZ|-}} series {{SS|-}} [[Link]] [[amiibo]], after Link has visited the [[Depths]] for the first time. The White Sword of the Sky has a base attack power of 24 and a max [[Durability]] of 45 (70 when [[Fuse]]d). It cannot naturally receive [[Weapon Bonus]]es and has no special properties. ==Trivia== * Although the White Sword of the Sky is known as the Goddess Sword in {{BotW|-}}, it instead resembles the [[Goddess White Sword]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:Goddess Sword (BOTW) Official Artwork.jpg|Artwork of the Goddess Sword from {{BotW|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Goddess Sword }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |items= TotK }}
